lines: ：“琉璃川小姐，你也不希望和你一起逃亡的领民受到伤害吧？”
高耸的城堡内，叶海斜靠着厚重的橡木椅背，嘴角带着一丝玩味看着眼前这位脸色略显苍白的大小姐。
琉璃川千代绝望的闭上了眼睛，虽然在带着族人和城内的领民往枫叶领地逃亡的时候就已经有了一丝心理准备，但当她真的面对这一幕的时候心中那一抹希冀终究还是消散了。
或许当初直接自我了断才是更好的选择吧……
可是她不能这样做，身为琉璃川大公的女儿，琉璃川千代必须带领自己的臣民找到一条活路，她有这个责任，也有这个义务。
她强忍着眼角的泪水，深吸了一口气后睁开泛着水光的大眼睛说道：“我明白了，只要您愿意为随我而来的臣民提供最基本的生活保障，那么接下来的一切我都会听阁下的安排。”
“哈哈哈……好好好，我的枫叶领虽然不大，甚至光论面积都比不上你们琉璃川公国的十分之一，但养活几千个逃难至此的难民还是没什么问题的。”
叶海忍不住笑出了声，琉璃川啊琉璃川，你也有今天。
当初琉璃川大公拒绝与枫叶领联姻合作的时候不知道有没有想到有一天她的女儿会主动找上门来寻求帮助呢。
枫叶领作为叶家传承并经营了三代的领地，面积大约在五千平方公里左右，听起来似乎不小，但与面积超十万平方公里的琉璃川公国相比自然是差得远了。
甚至还不如人家的零头。
即使现在琉璃川公国遭受到了外部进攻，并且琉璃川大公的三位儿子还纷纷举兵争抢地盘。
但即使这样，四分五裂之后的琉璃川公国无论是哪一块都比叶海的枫叶领大。
没办法，谁让叶家祖上传承下来的只是个伯爵爵位呢，和人家大公自然是没法比。
或许这也是当初琉璃川大公拒绝叶海父亲联姻请求的重要原因之一，你一个小小的伯爵之子凭什么和人家大公的女儿联姻呢？
枫叶领不大，由一座主城、两座次级城池、八个小镇以及数以百计的村庄组成。
所谓主城，是明斯克帝国官方定下的标准，要求很直白。
城池的城墙周长超过12公里，且城墙的高度必须超过12米，厚度必须超过4米。
而次级城池，那便是有城墙却达不到这个标准的城市。
至于小镇，人口超过三千的聚集地便是小镇。
一般这种小镇也会建造城墙保护自己，不过多数局限于有限的财力与人力，所建造出来的最多只能算是围墙。
就像枫叶领域内一座名为图尔奈的小镇，那里的围墙便只有不到四米高，厚度更是只有三十多厘米。
不过对于一座小镇来说够用了，足够防范多数在野外游荡的野兽了。
甚至于一些具备超凡实力的低阶魔兽也很少有能越过四米高墙的。
叶海晃了晃脑袋，将脑海中杂乱的思绪抛开，高声喊道：“蒂芙尼，你过来带我的贴身女仆下去换套衣服，要穿我让人准备的那种女仆装。”
“贴身女仆……”
琉璃川千代的脸色有些难堪，虽然意识到自己的未来恐怕不会太光明，但没想到居然会是女仆这个身份。
她没有奢望能够成为正式的伯爵夫人，但纵使没有身份成为被叶海当做金丝雀圈养都比这个身份好吧。
还不如情妇……
至少情妇不用照顾别人的起居，甚至一些受宠的情妇还会有专门的女仆伺候着呢。
明斯克帝国并没有限制帝国内的贵族娶几个妻子，只要你有能力，想娶几个就娶几个。
但能够正式登记到帝国官方贵族名册里且享有遗产继承权的伯爵夫人可就只有一个。
琉璃川千代本以为自己至少会成为没有继承权的普通夫人之一，结果事实显然更加凄惨……

: "Miss Liulicuan, you don't want the people who are fleeing with you to be harmed, right?"
In the towering castle, Ye Hai leaned against the back of a heavy oak chair and looked at the slightly pale young lady in front of him with a hint of amusement.
Rurigawa Chiyo closed her eyes in despair. Although she had been psychologically prepared when she led her tribe and the people in the city to escape to the Maple Leaf Territory, the hope in her heart finally dissipated when she actually faced this scene.
Perhaps it would have been a better choice to commit suicide directly at the beginning...
But she couldn't do this. As the daughter of the Grand Duke of Rurigawa, Rurigawa Chiyo must lead her subjects to find a way to survive. She has this responsibility and obligation.
She held back the tears in the corners of her eyes, took a deep breath, opened her big watery eyes and said, "I understand, as long as you are willing to provide the most basic living security for the subjects who come with me, then I will listen to your arrangements for everything that follows."
"Hahaha... Okay, okay, although my Maple Leaf Territory is not big, even less than one-tenth of your Liulicuan Principality in terms of area, there is still no problem in feeding thousands of refugees who have fled here."
Ye Hai couldn't help laughing, Liulichuan, Liulichuan, you also have today.
When Grand Duke Liulicuan refused to cooperate with the Maple Leaf Territory by marriage, I wonder if he had thought that one day her daughter would come to her for help.
The Maple Leaf Territory, a territory inherited and managed by the Ye family for three generations, covers an area of ​​about 5,000 square kilometers. It sounds like a lot, but it is naturally far behind the Liulicuan Principality, which covers an area of ​​over 100,000 square kilometers.
Not even a fraction of others.
Even now the Duke of Liulicuan is under attack from outside, and the three sons of Duke Liulicuan are still fighting for territory.
But even so, no matter which part of the Liulichuan Principality after it fell apart, it was larger than Ye Hai's Maple Leaf Territory.
There is no way, who made the ancestors of the Ye family inherit only the title of earl, which is naturally incomparable with other people's grand dukes.
Perhaps this was one of the important reasons why Grand Duke Liulicuan rejected Ye Hai's father's marriage request. Why would you, the son of a little earl, marry the daughter of another Grand Duke?
The Maple Leaf Territory is small, consisting of a main city, two secondary cities, eight small towns and hundreds of villages.
The so-called main city is the official standard set by the Minsk Empire, and the requirements are very straightforward.
The perimeter of the city wall exceeds 12 kilometers, and the height of the city wall must exceed 12 meters and the thickness must exceed 4 meters.
As for secondary cities, they are cities that have city walls but cannot meet this standard.
As for a small town, a gathering place with a population of more than 3,000 is a small town.
Generally, such small towns will also build walls to protect themselves, but most of them are limited by limited financial resources and manpower, and what they build can only be regarded as walls at best.
Just like a small town called Tournai in Maple Leaf Territory, the wall there is only less than four meters high and only more than 30 centimeters thick.
But it's enough for a small town, and enough to protect against most of the wild beasts that roam the wild.
Even some low-level monsters with extraordinary strength can rarely cross the four-meter-high wall.
Ye Hai shook his head, put aside the messy thoughts in his mind, and shouted loudly: "Tiffany, come here and take my personal maid down to change clothes. She wants to wear the maid outfit I asked someone to prepare."
"Personal maid..."
Rurigawa Chiyo looked a little embarrassed. Although she realized that her future might not be too bright, she never expected that she would be a maid.
She had no extravagant hope of becoming an official countess, but even if she had no status, it would be better than being raised as a canary by Ye Hai.
Worse than mistress...
At least the mistress does not have to take care of other people's daily life, and even some favored mistresses will have dedicated maids to serve them.
The Minsk Empire does not restrict how many wives the nobles in the empire can marry. As long as you have the ability, you can marry as many as you want.
But there is only one countess who can be officially registered in the official imperial nobility list and enjoys inheritance rights.
Rurigawa Chiyo thought that she would at least become one of the ordinary ladies without inheritance rights, but the truth turned out to be even more miserable...
